title: Aim2Balance
tagline: EU-hosted AI chat platform with EUR billing and cross-provider token tracking
description: Co-founded and built an AI chat platform forked from LibreChat, hosted in the EU. Engineered EUR-based billing with Stripe wallets, a Chrome extension tracking token consumption across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, and cross-platform mobile apps via Capacitor.
pullQuote: We forked an open-source chat platform into an EU-hosted product handling 10,000 sessions a day.

title: Roofcast
tagline: Decentralized prediction market for real estate on Polygon
description: A Web3 DApp built on Polygon using Gnosis Conditional Tokens for real estate prediction markets. Users stake on property value outcomes with on-chain settlement. Integrated wallet connections, token creation, and real-time market data.
pullQuote: On-chain prediction markets where real money settles on real estate outcomes.

title: JEOfferte
tagline: Quotation management platform for Dutch SMEs
description: A quotation and offer management system replacing spreadsheets and email chains for 110+ Dutch SMEs. Single source of truth for quotes, invoices, and client communications — closing deals 62% faster.
pullQuote: Quotes used to take three emails and a phone call. Now they take ninety seconds.

title: Meshi
tagline: Geo-based food matching platform connecting users with nearby providers
description: A food-tech platform with a geo-based matching engine connecting users to nearby food providers. Built location-aware search, real-time availability, and a streamlined ordering flow. Part of the Zoof-it product suite.
pullQuote: Matching hungry users with the closest kitchen — in under two seconds.

title: Intex Exchange
tagline: Real-time cryptocurrency trading platform with WebSocket data feeds
description: A crypto exchange with real-time trading interfaces, WebSocket price feeds, and order book visualization. Built a shared component library that cut development cycles from 8 to 5 days and a CRUD table abstraction improving feature delivery by 50%.
pullQuote: Real-time trading where milliseconds matter — and the component library that made it sustainable.

title: Exmodules
tagline: Web3 real estate DApp with tokenized property ownership
description: A Web3 real estate platform enabling tokenized property ownership and marketplace features. Built token creation flows, property listing interfaces, and wallet integration for on-chain real estate transactions.
pullQuote: Tokenizing real estate — turning bricks and mortar into tradeable on-chain assets.
